sentences.en: Some people insist that television does more harm than good.
sentences.zh: 有人坚持认为电视弊大于利。

sentences.en: The flood did a lot of harm to the crops.
sentences.zh: 洪水对农作物造成了很大的损害。

sentences.en: This kind of magazine can do harm to young people.
sentences.zh: 这种类型的杂志会对年轻人产生不良影响。

senses.zh: 损害, 危害, 伤害 -
